name: EPIC 201216797
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 7.7 solar radii and 1.02 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201216797 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.661819 (16th-84th percentiles 7.342196-7.998944), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201216797 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.0237 (16th-84th percentiles 0.92004-1.1381), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201216797: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4715.551 +/- 205 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 201216797 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2799.453125 (16th-84th percentiles 2691.953125-2905.585938), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.14 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,800 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.02 solar masses and 7.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,716 K at its surface.
